### The Leader and Criticism
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/the-leader-and-criticism
Passage: Nehemiah 2:18-19
Points:
- Criticism is an inevitable part of taking action and leading constructive change.
- Wise leaders evaluate critics by considering whether their opposition aligns with God's voice.
- Opponents outside God's work should be ignored rather than allowed to halt progress.
- Nehemiah succeeded through diligent planning, careful timing, and clear communication.
- Remaining close to God gives leaders the resolve to withstand persistent ridicule.

### Where Is God Calling You to Rise Up and Build?
Author: Chelsey DeMatteis
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women-september-14.html
Passage: Nehemiah 2:18
Points:
- God calls believers to act on His agenda rather than personal comfort or convenience.
- Rising and building requires stepping into kingdom assignments without fearing human opposition.
- Genuine dedication to God's mission inspires others to unite in service.
- God often aligns our deepest burdens with the specific tasks He wants us to undertake.
- Strength for the work comes from God, who promises to complete what He begins.
